explication: Niri is a scrollable-tiling Wayland compositor. User input and client protocol events are handled by the compositor state, which updates per-monitor workspaces and window layout, then renders output through the selected backend. Configuration, IPC, screencasting, screenshots, overview, accessibility, and external desktop integrations are important companion capabilities. Relationships below are limited to those shown by excerpts, SOURCE INDEX references, or README statements; unsampled wiring is not inferred.
